answer: Problem: clone mills stamp many voting keys from one payout parent. Mechanism: a newcomer reserves a single harvest slot on a public yarrow calendar (90-minute windows; one slot per funding parent) and publishes a 3-hop referral thread of earlier harvesters with disjoint parents. It prepays 5.5 POA of nectar that decays 0.4 POA for every missed window. Verification: the calendar rejects double-booked parents and checks hop-disjoint receipts. Failure: a colliding parent burns remaining nectar and cannot book a new slot for 5 epochs.
